plan.title: SRC-WDR-007 — Withdraw live RFQ with two bids

steps.note: Open the existing buyer-side RFQ prepared for the two-bid scenario.
Reach the published event's Participants list so a second bid can be entered on behalf of another invited vendor.
Add the second bid for the other invited vendor, matching the scenario's lower bid.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Confirm the buyer sees both bids before withdrawal.
Withdraw the whole project using the required audit reason.
Assert that the event is recorded as withdrawn.
Open the Order Activity drawer to inspect the withdrawal audit entry.
Verify the withdrawal reason is recorded in Order Activity.
Return to the buyer's Responses view after withdrawal.
Confirm both bid responses remain visible after withdrawal.
Switch to the available invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the withdrawn event in the vendor portal overview.
Confirm the vendor sees the event as withdrawn.
Open the pricing round to attempt a revision from the vendor side.
Verify the vendor cannot revise or submit a new bid after withdrawal.
